name: Paradisus Los Cabos
insider_take: Where desert luxury meets the dramatic convergence of the Pacific Ocean and Sea of Cortez at Land's End.
whats_special: This adults-only sanctuary sits on one of Mexico's most photographed coastlines, where Jacques Cousteau once called the surrounding waters "the world's aquarium." The resort features swim-up suites with direct ocean access and the exclusive YHI Spa, offering treatments inspired by ancient Mayan healing traditions.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the resort's signature restaurant during whale watching season (December-April) when gray whales migrate through these waters—you might spot them from your table.
dont_miss: Take the short boat ride to the iconic Arch of Cabo San Lucas (El Arco), a natural rock formation that marks the southernmost tip of Baja California. The nearby Lover's Beach is only accessible by water taxi and offers some of the region's best snorkeling among tropical fish and sea lions.
pros: Premium beachfront location with stunning Sea of Cortez views
All-inclusive luxury resort with comprehensive amenities
Multiple dining venues featuring international and local cuisine
cons: All-inclusive format may not appeal to independent travelers
Resort setting limits exploration of local Cabo culture
